genZNote: No cell wall at all, which is exactly why every beta-lactam you throw at it does nothing.

morphology.shape: Pleomorphic — no fixed shape due to absence of a cell wall
morphology.size: ~0.1-0.3 µm — among the smallest known free-living organisms
morphology.motility: Gliding motility via a specialized terminal attachment organelle
morphology.notes: Lacks a cell wall entirely, so it does not Gram stain and is intrinsically resistant to beta-lactam antibiotics

habitat.hostAssociation: Obligate human pathogen, no significant animal reservoir
habitat.environmentalOccurrence: Does not survive well outside the host

microscopy.stain: Cannot be visualized by standard Gram stain (no cell wall)

culture.growthCharacteristics: Extremely slow growing — can take 2-3 weeks in culture
culture.colonyMorphology: Tiny colonies with a characteristic "fried-egg" appearance under low magnification
culture.hemolysis: Beta-hemolytic on sheep/guinea pig blood agar (used diagnostically)

identificationClues: Does not Gram stain — lacks a cell wall entirely
"Fried-egg" colony appearance on specialized agar, but culture is impractically slow for routine diagnosis
PCR or serology is the practical diagnostic method
Cold agglutinins often present, though nonspecific
Presents as "walking pneumonia" — a milder, more gradual illness than typical bacterial pneumonia

diseases: Rare extrapulmonary complications (e.g. erythema multiforme, hemolytic anemia)
clinicalImportance.transmission: Respiratory droplets; spreads readily in close-contact settings such as schools, military barracks, and college dormitories
clinicalImportance.epidemiology: One of the most common causes of community-acquired "atypical" pneumonia, particularly in school-age children and young adults; outbreaks common in crowded living/working settings
clinicalImportance.labSignificance: Because it lacks a cell wall, it is intrinsically resistant to beta-lactam antibiotics (penicillins, cephalosporins) — treatment requires macrolides, tetracyclines, or fluoroquinolones instead

examFacts.importantTest: PCR or serology (culture is too slow for routine use)
examFacts.distinguishingFeature: Lacks a cell wall entirely — intrinsically resistant to beta-lactam antibiotics
